cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer with a PhD focus on trustworthy AI and medical NLP. In my recent work I designed and evaluated machine learning models that assess clinical AI systems, handling high-dimensional text data and uncertainty quantification. I also led a research centre where we built AI prototypes for real-world use, coordinating engineers, clinicians and external partners.

My experience with Python, deep-learning frameworks and probabilistic modelling matches the core technical needs of your role. While my background is not in computational physics, I have repeatedly adapted ML methods to new domains, from summarising medical papers to detecting disinformation, and I am comfortable learning domain-specific constraints such as PDE-based data.

I have managed interdisciplinary teams, organized international workshops, and overseen the full lifecycle of AI projects, from data preparation to deployment and monitoring. I look forward to bringing this practical, cross-functional approach to your Digital Twin environment and help accelerate fusion research.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
